findings.current: It was the fire dragon’s nest—the very essence of Scorching Yang Qi, born of the Fire Gate Clan’s martial arts.
findings.defect: The apposition makes the nest, rather than the fire dragon, sound like the essence of Scorching Yang Qi.
findings.rationale: The Heavenly Power Demon’s energy remains as the dragon’s nest; the dragon embodies the Fire Gate Clan’s Scorching Yang Qi.
findings.replacement: That energy served as the nest of the fire dragon, the very embodiment of Scorching Yang Qi born of the Fire Gate Clan’s martial arts.
findings.source: 열화문의 무공으로 비롯된 열양지기(熱陽之氣), 그 자체라 할 수 있는 화룡의 둥지로서.

findings.current: Everything passed on to me by the fire dragon’s massive body, which had felt like mine for a long time now.
findings.defect: “Passed on to me” suggests an inheritance or transfer rather than sensations reaching him through the dragon’s body.
findings.rationale: The surrounding lines concern wind and other sensations his consciousness perceives as real while inhabiting the dragon.
findings.replacement: Everything I felt through the fire dragon’s massive body, which had long since come to feel like my own.
findings.source: 이제는 오래전부터 내 것처럼 느껴지게 된 화룡의 거대한 몸뚱어리로부터 전해지는 모든 것이.

findings.defect: A forceful cry has become an order to stop.
findings.rationale: The source gives Jeok Cheongang a sharp, wordless shout that rouses the narrator; it does not tell him to halt.

findings.current:
Now the pain went beyond agony, numbing my mind.

And, as luck would have it—
findings.defect: The draft makes pain the thing numbing his mind and leaves the reason for his good fortune attached to what follows instead.
findings.rationale: The lightning containing the giant’s power numbs him; the narrator calls that numbness fortunate amid the ordeal.
findings.replacement:
That lightning, holding everything the giant had been, was numbing my mind past the point of pain.

Luckily for me.
findings.source:
한 거인의 모든 것이 담긴 그것은 이제는 고통을 넘어 정신을 마비시키고 있었다.

내게는 참으로 다행스럽게도.

summary: Three actionable findings: one misidentifies the source of the dragon’s qi, one changes a shout into a command, and one obscures what is numbing the narrator’s mind.
